results.name: jev-kit
results.title: Jev-kit
results.summary: Multi-component Claude Code integration kit wiring TypeSafe's Jev (a ~0.3s typed-decision model) into the agent loop: a PreToolUse tool-call guard ('Airlock', code rules first + one Jev question for the ambiguous ~7%), sub-agent tier right-sizing, a 'Belay' check that sends unverified 'done' claims back to the agent, plocate/Everything-based file search, a Jev-driven browser agent (vendored fork of browser-use's jev-ultrafast), plus installer/doctor/warm-daemon tooling; MIT, requires a TypeSafe API key, Linux/WSL2-first with a reduced-feature native Windows port

results.name: qwen3-8-27b-uncensored-hauhaucs-aggressive-gguf
results.title: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive-MTP-GGUF
results.summary: Community-produced GGUF quantization of Qwen3.8-27B with safety-refusal behavior deliberately stripped ('uncensored'/abliterated 'Aggressive' profile, publisher-claimed 0/465 refusals), published by pseudonymous Hugging Face contributor HauhauCS; ships multiple quant levels plus a vision projector and a custom 'FastMTP' speculative-decoding sidecar requiring a llama.cpp patch

results.name: fast-jev-compaction
results.title: Fast Jev Compaction
results.summary: Claude Code plugin/npm library that replaces the built-in compaction summary with a Jev (TypeSafe AI) scored prune of tool calls/results; depends on Claude Code's unshipped function-hooks feature and an early-access third-party API, and a filed issue shows its hook events go unrecognized (silent no-op) on a recent Claude Code build

results.name: claude-code-remote-prompt-hardening
results.title: Claude Code Remote Prompt Hardening
results.summary: env vars to block remote system prompt injection in Claude Code; operational hardening knowledge for security-sensitive environments

results.name: fzf
results.title: fzf
results.summary: General-purpose command-line fuzzy finder and interactive terminal toolkit — processes millions of items in milliseconds; event-driven architecture for custom workflows; shell integration (CTRL-R history, CTRL-T files, ALT-C directories) for bash/zsh/fish/nushell; preview window with image support; popup mode (tmux 3.3+/Zellij); single Go binary; MIT

results.name: jev
results.title: Jev (TypeSafe AI)
results.summary: Non-generative 'System One' classification model from TypeSafe AI — evaluates state and returns typed answers with calibrated probabilities (choice, score, noul/boolean) instead of generating text; trained with RLCD; reports up to 200x faster inference and 400x lower cost than LLMs on classification tasks; parallel multi-question evaluation per request; LangChain integration via langchain-typesafe; use cases include model routing, agent guardrails (auto-mode safety classification), and ticket triage

results.name: gvs5h-ledger-orchestration
results.title: GVS5H — Ledger-Based Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration
results.summary: Training-free multi-agent coding method where fresh instances of one model decompose problems and coordinate through a shared filesystem (plan, notes, current solution); Qwen3.8-27B rises from 69.2% to 92.4% pass@1 on LiveCodeBench Hard (exceeding Fable 5's 90.4%); GPT-5.6-Terra reaches 88.0% at 19% of Fable 5's cost; gains attributed to decomposition and persistent context; MIT/CC-BY-4.0

results.name: claude-api-prefilter-false-positive
results.title: Claude API Pre-Filter False-Positive Troubleshooting
results.summary: A field-tested diagnosis and fix recipe for Claude Code sessions blocked by the API pre-filter pattern-matching bio- or security-adjacent language, covering the four trigger surfaces, transcript-based diagnosis, and quick/deep fix protocols

results.name: qwen38-27b-200k-on-16gb
results.title: Qwen 3.8 27B at 200K Context on 16GB VRAM (tutorial)
results.summary: Practitioner recipe for running Qwen 3.8 27B UD-IQ4_XS at ~196K context and 50 t/s on a single RTX 5070 Ti (16GB) — prune non-ASCII rows from the embedding table and LM head (~700MB, ASCII-condensed variant published), offload the embedding table to CPU, disable MTP, use adaptive-KV streaming (llama.cpp fork) to page KV cache from host RAM, and quantize cache Q8 K / Q4 V

results.name: agenttrail
results.title: AgentTrail — local observability dashboard for AI coding agents
results.summary: Local, open-source observability layer for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any tool that edits files), shipped as two independent npm-installed views in one repo. "Map" (`npx agenttrail`) combines a PLAN.md convention with observed file changes into a live component map with dependency links and session trails; a completed component re-lights when its files change again, and `npx agenttrail init` can scaffold the plan and wire optional Claude Code hooks. "Kitchen" (`npx agenttrail-kitchen .`, public experimental preview) is a separate Three.js 3D view that turns native agent todos and local Codex/Claude session logs — plus optional Cursor hooks — into a cooking-themed board (chefs, tickets, delivery). Both services bind to 127.0.0.1 only, require no account or cloud calls, and do not launch or control agents, only observe local files and logs. Map does not yet parse Claude Code's newer TaskCreate/TaskUpdate todo format (only legacy TodoWrite); native Cursor live behavior and Windows are unverified per the project's own FAQ. JavaScript, MIT license, single contributor (114 commits), 968 GitHub stars and 70 forks as of this review; created 2026-08-21, last pushed 2026-09-09 (no commits in the ~7 weeks before this review).
